title: Does Debate Actually Help a Weak Judge Supervise a Strong Expert? A Scaled-Down Replication

original_idea.body:
# Scaled-Down Weak-Judge Debate Replication

Compare judge-alone, consultancy, debate with a deliberately weaker judge model.
